svg.title: xatc: eventual architecture
svg.text: Automated US FAA-style voice ATC for X-Plane 12. A deterministic ATC engine decides every word; AI models only listen, speak, and (optionally) help classify what the pilot said.
• apt.dat: Global Airports + Custom Scenery, by scenery_packs.ini priority (*GLOBAL_AIRPORTS* marker)
• 1200 atc data/atc.dat: ARTCC/TRACON airspace polygons and frequencies
• default data/CIFP/<ICAO>.dat: SIDs, STARs, approaches · earth_fix.dat / earth_nav.dat: fix coordinates
Python 3.14 · asyncio · contracts.py is the shared interface
ATIS · Clearance · Ground · Tower · Departure · Center (+ sectors) · Approach
from apt.dat 1050–1056 + atc.dat · the tuned COM decides who answers
ground: taxi w/o clearance, off route, incursion
airborne: altitude (Mode C), heading, speed, squawk
TWR → DEP → CTR → APP → TWR → GND, one-shot
check-in accepted only after a real handoff
"are you with me?" · Center sectors · go-arounds
hiss, squelch; signal strength by distance
ATIS loops on the ATIS frequency
speaks ATC text word for word
latest OFP by username / user id
mic audio in / radio audio out
